description: Run scripts/commands on Intune-managed devices via Endpoint Manager (MDM push) - code execution on every enrolled endpoint.
prerequisite_privilege: Intune Administrator / Endpoint Manager script or remediation rights
abuse_primitive: Push a PowerShell script / proactive remediation to enrolled devices as SYSTEM.

telemetry.detail: Intune/Endpoint Manager audit log records the script assignment/push (management-plane). Default-on.
The pushed script executes on each device as SYSTEM and is caught on-host by EDR.

notes: Loud on-host (many endpoints run the payload) but the Intune push itself resembles legitimate management; EDR is the reliable catch.
